low.title: Full-Day Vukovar Art Route on a Low Budget
low.summary: A simple, creative, and affordable day filled with river views, exterior art, and low-cost local meals.

schedule.title: Danube Promenade Wake-Up Walk
schedule.description: Start the morning along the river, spotting small sculptures, murals, and artistic corners.

schedule.title: Eltz Manor Exterior
schedule.description: Admire the beautiful Baroque architecture and take photos around the riverside park.

schedule.title: Free/Exterior Museum Areas
schedule.description: Check out the free sections and outdoor displays related to Vukovar’s cultural history.

schedule.title: Low-Cost Local Lunch
schedule.description: Grab a cheap traditional meal — daily menus, simple stews, or local soups.

schedule.title: Town Center Art Corners
schedule.description: Walk through restored streets and look for murals, decorative facades, and hidden art spots.

schedule.title: Budget Café Break
schedule.description: Coffee, tea, or juice in a simple café — perfect for resting without spending much.

schedule.title: Riverside Sunset Sketch or Photo Time
schedule.description: Finish the day by sketching or photographing the Danube at sunset.

medium.title: Balanced Full-Day Vukovar Art Experience
medium.summary: A comfortable but affordable art-oriented route with museums, pretty streets, and well-priced local food.

schedule.title: Morning Coffee by the River
schedule.description: A smooth start to the day with a drink and Danube views.

schedule.title: Eltz Manor Museum – Art Highlights
schedule.description: Visit the key exhibitions of the City Museum, focusing on art and cultural displays.

schedule.title: Medium-Budget Local Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy a solid traditional meal — good quality without being fancy.

schedule.title: Architectural Art Walk
schedule.description: Check out heritage buildings, restored facades, and artistic architectural details.

schedule.title: Small Gallery or Cultural Center
schedule.description: Visit a local gallery or temporary exhibition if available.

schedule.title: Dessert or Coffee Break
schedule.description: Relax in a comfortable café with a sweet bite or drink.

schedule.title: Evening Riverfront Walk
schedule.description: End the day with calm riverside views and soft evening light.

high.title: High-End Vukovar Art Day
high.summary: A premium art route with detailed museum visits, refined local meals, and the best scenic spots.

schedule.title: Quality Café Breakfast
schedule.description: Start your day with a good breakfast in a nice café overlooking the river.

schedule.title: Eltz Manor – Full Artistic Tour
schedule.description: Explore the full museum floors: art collections, interior design, cultural history, and elegant galleries.

schedule.title: High-Quality Local Lunch
schedule.description: Taste refined Slavonian dishes prepared with extra care and presentation.

schedule.title: Signature Architecture Route
schedule.description: Walk through the most beautiful heritage streets and artistic building facades.

schedule.title: Extended Gallery Visit
schedule.description: Visit a high-quality gallery, artist hub, or art-focused cultural space.

schedule.title: Premium Dessert Café Stop
schedule.description: Enjoy a beautifully prepared dessert or a specialty non-alcoholic drink.

schedule.title: Golden-Hour Riverfront Walk
schedule.description: End with breathtaking river views as the sun sets.

comfortable.title: Luxury Full-Day Art Journey Through Vukovar
comfortable.summary: A premium, polished art-focused day featuring fine dining, curated museum experiences, elegant cafés, and the best scenic views.

schedule.title: Elegant Breakfast with River View
schedule.description: Begin with a luxurious breakfast in a top-tier café near the Danube.

schedule.title: Private or Guided Eltz Manor Art Experience
schedule.description: A detailed, curated exploration of exhibitions, architecture, and artistic heritage.

schedule.title: Fine Dining Local-Inspired Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy a premium take on traditional Slavonian cuisine with artistic plating.

schedule.title: Exclusive Architecture Walk
schedule.description: Visit the most impressive heritage buildings with time for premium photography and appreciation.

schedule.title: Top-Class Gallery or Artisan Studio
schedule.description: Explore a refined gallery or artisan workspace showcasing high-end works.

schedule.title: Luxury Café Break
schedule.description: Relax in an upscale café or patisserie with top-quality desserts.

schedule.title: Sunset Promenade Experience
schedule.description: End with a slow golden-hour walk along the Danube — the perfect finish to a luxury art day.
